text:
All five Gate 2 revisions have been applied and validated across `header.json` and `units-001.json`–`units-005.json`:

1. **`FR-6` / `AC-5` (Page-scoped undo/redo without page switching):**
   - Updated the history decision in `header.json` and removed `activePageId` from `ObservedAppState` / `ObservedStandaloneAppState` (`U05`, `U06`, `U07`) and removed the `StoreDelta.applyTo` / `AppStateDelta.applyTo` page switch (`U05`, `U06`).
   - Updated `U24` (`packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx`) to maintain per-page undo/redo stacks (`pageHistoryStacks`) and swap `this.history.undoStack` and `this.history.redoStack` in-place when `activePageId` changes so page switches are never recorded in history and undo/redo on a page applies only to that page's changes.
   - Updated tests in `U29` (`packages/element/tests/pages.test.ts`) and `U30` (`packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx`).

2. **`FR-7` / `AC-1` (Single opt-in switch `UIOptions.canvasActions.pages`, default `false`):**
   - Updated the `PageBar` gating decision in `header.json`.
   - Removed `pages: true` from `DEFAULT_UI_OPTIONS` in `U01`, removed `UIConfig["enabled"].pages` in `U07` and `U12`, and removed `pagesUIEnabled` and `?? true` fallbacks in `U19` (`Footer.tsx`), `U20` (`MobileMenu.tsx`), `U21` (`LayerUI.tsx`), and `U24` (`App.tsx`).
   - Updated `U30` (`packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx`) and docs (`U36`, `U39`, `U41`) to use `UIOptions={{ canvasActions: { pages: true } }}`.

3. **Enable tab bar in `excalidraw-app/App.tsx`:**
   - Added `U28` (`excalidraw-app/App.tsx`) setting `pages: true` in `UIOptions.canvasActions`.

4. **`FR-18` / `AC-10` / `AC-11` (Share links & local autosave round-trip tests and coverage tags):**
   - Updated `U08` (`packages/excalidraw/appState.ts`) so `activePageId` has `{ browser: true, export: true, server: true }` in `APP_STATE_STORAGE_CONF`.
   - Added `U31` (`excalidraw-app/tests/pages.test.tsx`) testing default `PageBar` rendering in `ExcalidrawApp`, the share-link (`exportToBackend` / `importFromBackend`) multi-page round-trip (`FR-18`, `AC-10`), and the local autosave (`LocalData` / `importFromLocalStorage`) round-trip (`FR-17`, `AC-11`).
   - Dropped `FR-17`, `AC-10`, `AC-11`, and `FR-19` coverage tags from units that do not implement them (`U07`, `U11`, `U16`, `U21`, `U24`, `U25`, `U30`).

5. **Export via `exportScene` in tests:**
   - Updated `U30` (`packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx`) to test active-page visual exports via `exportScene` and `exportToClipboard` instead of the internal `exportToSvg` / `exportToCanvas` functions.
